about: 30 HAND-MADE support tickets for the Jev study book. Written by hand for this book on 2026-10-04, not taken from any real company or dataset. The labels are one person's judgement. Some tickets are hard on purpose. Labels: team (billing, technical, shipping, account, sales); urgency 0 = can wait, 1 = soon, 2 = today; frustration 0 = calm, 1 = frustrated but civil, 2 = very angry.

tickets.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my March invoice. Could you refund one of the charges?
Our whole team gets a 500 error on every page since 9am. Nobody can work. Please fix this now!
Where is my package? Tracking has said 'label created' for ten days.
I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives.
Do you offer a discount if we buy 200 seats for our company?
This is the THIRD time I am writing. You took my money twice and nobody answers. I will report you to my bank today.
The CSV export puts all dates in the wrong column. I can fix it by hand in Excel, so no rush.
The box arrived crushed and the lamp inside is broken.
Please change the email address on my profile to my new work address.
We are comparing you with two other vendors. Can someone show us a demo of the enterprise plan next week?
Your API returns 429 errors even though we send far fewer requests than our plan allows. Our checkout is failing for customers right now.
I cancelled my subscription last month but you charged me again this month. Why?
Someone logged into my account from another country. I did not do this. Lock it please, immediately.
Can I change the delivery address for order 55120? It has not shipped yet.
Absolutely useless. The app crashes every time I open it. I want to speak to a manager.
Is there a yearly plan? Paying monthly is annoying for our accounting team.
My invoice shows the wrong company name and VAT number. Please send a corrected one before Friday.
The mobile app logs me out every few minutes. Annoying but I can use the website instead.
I need to add two colleagues as admins on our workspace.
The courier left my parcel at the wrong house and the neighbour says it is not there.
We would like a quote for the premium support add-on for our three offices.
Why did my bill go up from 40 to 65 dollars? Nobody told me about a price change.
Two-factor codes never arrive by SMS, so I am locked out of my account and can't approve payroll due today.
The webhook signature check fails after your update yesterday. Payments are not being confirmed on our side.
I paid for express shipping but the order took two weeks. I want the express fee back.
Love the product! Just wondering if the student discount also covers the team plan?
After I upgraded my plan, the new features still do not show up in my account.
Your delivery driver was rude and threw my package over the fence. Disgusting service.
Please delete my account and all my data.
I can't log in, and I also see a charge I don't recognise. Help.
